title: Bilvata
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Arakhin 11a, reporting Rabbi Yochanan; Rashi explains that this is a sage's name. There, 28b, Chizkiyah bar Biluto may be his son. Perhaps his own name was Shimon, as at the beginning of Pesachim chapter 4: Rabbi Shimon Bulota in Rabbi Chanina's name.

notes.text: The name forms Bilvata, Biluto and Bulota are preserved. Both the proposed son and the possible first name Shimon are hedged suggestions.
